distributed-abuse-control.note: One authoritative Redis-backed layer keyed on stable route-family across all public endpoint families; family-collapse + cross-replica sharing proven on real Redis; per-family outage policy + Retry-After.

trusted-proxy-identity.note: Topology-aware resolver (CADDY_EDGE/CLOUDFLARE_EDGE/DIRECT, fail-closed in prod) feeds the single authoritative abuse-control layer; confidence buckets prevent unattributed claims consuming a real client's budget.

sessions-revocation.note: Durable PostgreSQL-backed revocable sessions: refresh rotation, reuse detection (family revoke, atomic/single-use under concurrency), logout/logout-all, inventory, cleanup, immediate hard-revocation cutoff; CSRF Origin validation for cookie-auth mutations. Real-PG 8/8 + unit 24/24.

privileged-mfa.note: RFC 6238 TOTP (vector-verified), AES-256-GCM secret at rest, single-use recovery codes, 5-min step-up freshness, self-bypass denial; requireStepUp wired to pricing approve/activate + reusable for the rest. Unit 10/10 + real-PG 4/4. Broad route roll-out is mechanical follow-on.

configuration-boundary.note: Zod configSchema boundary with z.infer-derived type + redactedConfig() secret masking; env-specific rules; unit 7/7. process.env sweep is mechanical follow-on.

typed-errors-safe-logs.note: DomainError base + central mapErrorToHttp (categories + SQLSTATE classification, never message-matching, no err.message leak) wired to app.onError; pino PII/secret redaction. Unit 5/5. console.* sweep (mostly scripts) is follow-on.

db-client-composition-shutdown.note: Transaction retry (40001/40P01) outside failed tx, bounded jittered backoff, statement/connect timeouts, Prometheus pool metrics, slow-query fingerprint without values, ordered graceful shutdown, startup config validation ALL already present and verified; added readiness-false-before-drain (lifecycle flag → /health/ready 503 while liveness stays 200). Unit 4/4. Modular-lazy composition of the eager Registry singleton deferred as an acceptable design (it is testable via getInstance and startup-validated).
